Name: JinHsiang Upgradeable Chests
Author: abroalmor
Description:
Upgradeable Chests
Upgradeable Chests adds a dedicated craftable chest that grows through copper, iron, gold, and iridium tiers. Each tier increases its storage capacity and unlocks additional upgrade slots.
Install utility components to move full chests, transfer items between containers, control which items may enter, or access a chest remotely through a linked satchel.
Your stored items and installed upgrades are preserved when upgrading or moving a chest.
[heading]Chest tiers[/heading]
[table][tr][th]Tier[/th]
[th]Capacity[/th]
[th]Upgrade slots[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Normal[/td]
[td]36[/td]
[td]0[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Copper[/td]
[td]48[/td]
[td]1[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Iron[/td]
[td]60[/td]
[td]2[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Gold[/td]
[td]72[/td]
[td]3[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Iridium[/td]
[td]96[/td]
[td]4[/td]
[/tr]
[/table][heading]Crafting and upgrading[/heading]
Craft an [b]Upgradeable Chest[/b] using:
[list]
[*]50 Wood[/*]
[/list]To upgrade it:
[list=1]
[*]Hold 5 bars of the metal required for the next tier.[/*]
[*]Use them directly on the Upgradeable Chest.[/*]
[*]The chest upgrades immediately without losing its contents.[/*]
[/list]The upgrade order is:
[b]Normal → Copper → Iron → Gold → Iridium[/b]
Each upgrade requires 5 corresponding bars.
[heading]Upgrade components[/heading]
Components are installed from left to right in the available upgrade slots.
Right-click an installed component slot to remove it. Components behind it automatically move left to fill the empty slot.
Chest Mover Upgrade
Allows an upgraded chest to be picked up while preserving:
[list]
[*]Stored items[/*]
[*]Installed components[/*]
[*]Component settings[/*]
[*]Chest color[/*]
[*]Filter lists[/*]
[/list]Install the component, then use the tool button on the chest to pick it up.
Recipe:
[list]
[*]5 Iron Bars[/*]
[*]25 Wood[/*]
[/list]Push Upgrade
Slowly sends items from the upgraded chest to a linked container.
To use it:
[list=1]
[*]Hold the Push Upgrade.[/*]
[*]Use it on the destination container to record its location.[/*]
[*]Install it into an Upgradeable Chest.[/*]
[/list]Items are transferred gradually, one item at a time. This behavior leaves room for future speed upgrades.
Removing the component clears its saved destination so it can be linked somewhere else.
Recipe:
[list]
[*]2 Gold Bars[/*]
[*]1 Battery Pack[/*]
[/list]Pull Upgrade
Works in the opposite direction of the Push Upgrade. It slowly retrieves items from a linked container and places them inside the upgraded chest.
To use it:
[list=1]
[*]Hold the Pull Upgrade.[/*]
[*]Use it on the source container to record its location.[/*]
[*]Install it into an Upgradeable Chest.[/*]
[/list]Removing the component clears its saved source.
Recipe:
[list]
[*]2 Gold Bars[/*]
[*]1 Battery Pack[/*]
[/list]Whitelist Upgrade
Only item types included in its configured list may enter the chest.
To configure it:
[list=1]
[*]Open your player inventory.[/*]
[*]Right-click the Whitelist Upgrade before installing it.[/*]
[*]Click an item in your inventory to add that item type to the list.[/*]
[*]Click an item shown in the list to remove it.[/*]
[*]Close the settings screen and install the component.[/*]
[/list]Items used for configuration are not consumed.
An empty whitelist prevents every item from entering the chest.
Recipe:
[list]
[*]1 Cloth[/*]
[*]1 Iron Bar[/*]
[*]10 Fiber[/*]
[/list]Blacklist Upgrade
Prevents item types included in its configured list from entering the chest.
Configure it from the player inventory in the same way as the Whitelist Upgrade.
An empty blacklist does not block anything.
Recipe:
[list]
[*]1 Cloth[/*]
[*]1 Iron Bar[/*]
[*]10 Coal[/*]
[/list]Whitelist and Blacklist Upgrades cannot be installed in the same chest.
Filter rules apply to:
[list]
[*]Manual item placement[/*]
[*]Push Upgrades[/*]
[*]Pull Upgrades[/*]
[*]Automate machine output[/*]
[/list]Existing items are not deleted or removed when a filter is installed.
[heading]Linked Chest Satchel[/heading]
The [b]Linked Chest Satchel[/b] provides remote access to one Upgradeable Chest.
To bind it:
[list=1]
[*]Hold the satchel.[/*]
[*]Use it directly on an Upgradeable Chest.[/*]
[*]The satchel records the chest's location and tile coordinates.[/*]
[/list]To use it:
[list=1]
[*]Open your player inventory.[/*]
[*]Right-click the satchel.[/*]
[*]The linked chest opens remotely.[/*]
[/list]Each satchel stores its own destination, so multiple satchels can be linked to different chests without interfering with one another.
Recoloring satchels
Satchels can use the same color palette style as vanilla chests.
[list=1]
[*]Open your player inventory.[/*]
[*]Hold Shift and right-click a satchel.[/*]
[*]Select a color from the palette.[/*]
[/list]The selected color and chest binding are saved separately for each satchel.
Recipe:
[list]
[*]1 Cloth[/*]
[*]1 Gold Bar[/*]
[*]1 Battery Pack[/*]
[/list][heading]Automate compatibility[/heading]
Automate is supported but not required.
When an Upgradeable Chest has a Whitelist or Blacklist Upgrade installed, items inserted by Automate must follow the same filter rules as manually inserted items.
If Automate is not installed, every other feature continues to work normally.
[heading]Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI 4.0.0 or later.[/*]
[*]Download this mod.[/*]
[*]Extract the ZIP into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]No other mods are required.
[heading]Configuration[/heading]
The generated configuration file allows you to change:
[list]
[*]Metal bars required for chest tier upgrades[/*]
[*]Capacity of each chest tier[/*]
[*]Item transfer interval[/*]
[/list][heading]Compatibility and saved data[/heading]
[list]
[*]Existing Upgradeable Chests from earlier versions remain supported.[/*]
[*]Chest contents remain inside when upgrading or moving the chest.[/*]
[*]Installed components and their settings are stored with each chest.[/*]
[*]Push, Pull, and Linked Chest Satchel connections use the location name and tile coordinates.[/*]
[*]Cross-location item transfer and remote chest access are supported.[/*]
[/list][heading]Mod API[/heading]
Upgradeable Chests includes an API for other SMAPI mods.
Extension mods can:
[list]
[*]Register additional installable upgrade components[/*]
[*]Add component update behavior[/*]
[*]Read installed components[/*]
[*]Check the number of available upgrade slots[/*]
[*]Check whether an item is accepted by an installed filter[/*]
[/list]API documentation is included in the download.
[heading]Credits[/heading]
Stardew Valley and the original chest artwork are by ConcernedApe.
Some included sprites were created or redrawn using AI-assisted tools, including ComfyUI and OpenAI ImageGen.
